title: ConfigSourceActionEnvelope
description: Machine-readable result of a goobers init config-source action, emitted by `goobers init --template=quickstart --source-tree <path> --json`.

action.description: Which config-source action produced this envelope.

version.description: Envelope version, incremented when the payload shape changes.

created.description: Paths written by the action, relative to the seeded source tree.

skipped.description: Paths left untouched because they already existed.

path.description: Absolute path to the seeded config source tree.

nextCommand.description: Ready-to-run command that validates the seeded source tree.
